prefabs.name: 2 x ZSU 01
prefabs.author: coconutcockpit
prefabs.description: Two ZU-23 anti-aircraft gun emplacements with support vehicles and sandbag fortifications in Syria; suitable for air defense or point-defense scenarios against rotary-wing or low-level fixed-wing threats.

prefabs.name: Enemy Artillery Base
prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)
prefabs.description: A fortified Syrian artillery position with integrated air defense (Tor SAM, Grad MLRS), armor (T-72B/B3), transport, and support infrastructure including FARP, command facilities, and defensive positions. Suitable for strike missions, CAS training, or as a persistent redfor base.

prefabs.name: EWR Site 1
prefabs.author: Bug Smasher Pilot (hgoc)
prefabs.description: 4 variations of Red EWR Sites fortified with close-range SAMs. I love using these as ground targets because they break up the monotony of simply taking out vehicles and SAMs. Meant to be placed on the Syria map, but work well as templates for any map.

prefabs.name: FARP Copperhead
prefabs.author: nihprodne
prefabs.description: A fortified forward airfield in Syria with FARP pad, fuel depot, ammunition and cargo storage, defended by HESCO barriers, sandbags, and revetments with support buildings and vehicles. Suitable for helicopter operations or as a strike package staging area.

prefabs.name: FOB Black Lantern
prefabs.author: nihprodne
prefabs.description: A forward operating base in Syria with command center, HESCO fortifications, watchtowers, vehicle shelters, and supply containers; suitable for ground combat scenarios or as a defensive position to be attacked or defended.
